title: Taskbase 2023 — WordPress/Elementor homepage
notes: Wayback 2023-06-02, WordPress 6.1 + Elementor Pro + HubSpot. Restored from the archive: the chunks Elementor pulls at runtime (Swiper 5.3.6, text-editor) plus dialogs-manager 4.9.0 taken byte-for-byte from the archived elementor 3.9.2 plugin zip on downloads.wordpress.org. With Swiper back, the hero RevSlider, the partner strip and the testimonial carousel all run. The archived post-16.css is the 2023-05-13 save and has no rules for the fourth benefit column, so its rocket icon and "10x faster time to market" heading drew at inherited size and colour - invisible on the purple band; museum.css carries that column's own rules from the next archived save of the same page (2023-10-23). The HubSpot form init script was dropped, it threw; the form is dead by design. Still missing: the RevSlider arrow images (uploads/2022/04/{next,prev}-button-*.png and two svgcustom SVGs), absent from every capture, so museum.css hides them rather than draw broken glyphs; and the Elementor Pro nav-menu chunk, never crawled. The ElementsKit client-logo slider does not initialise either, so museum.css lays its logo strip out the way the running carousel showed it.
